name: cursorlens
description: A cursor-anchored macOS screen context assistant demo.

scripts.check: node --check src/main/index.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/renderer/app.js
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac dmg zip

extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: CursorLens captures a small area around the pointer only when you invoke it, so the assistant can answer questions about that UI.
